name: Chernasardo Chomper
description: These animal snares have been repurposed to discourage unwanted intruders. When a creature steps onto the snare, jaws with sharpened teeth close around the creature's leg.
disable: DC 26 Acrobatics check (trained) to step clear the snare before it springs, or DC 22 Thievery check (trained) to trigger the trap harmlessly

offensiveAbilities.name: Bite
offensiveAbilities.description:
Trigger A creature moves into the space containing the trap

Effect The trap's jaws snap shut on the creature's leg, dealing 4d8+14 piercing damage (DC 26 basic Reflex save). On a failure, the creature becomes caught in the trap and is Immobilized (Escape DC 22).
